purpose: Independent validation of regularized FAR-Cal after the original SUMO test was inspected
inference: Average paired effects across model and fault seeds within each episode, then bootstrap the 30 complete episodes with 2000 resamples.
superiority_rule: Both comparator-minus-candidate 95% episode-bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero and candidate aggregate 90% coverage must be at least 0.88.
data_boundary: No episode with seed 50001 through 50030 existed in the replication directory when this registry was committed.
